scope: Previously unauthored query wording against all real profile vectors. Conditioned routing uses separately declared complete component proof; free paraphrases are also measured and never claim hard activation.

positives.query: A short bob whose lower contour wraps the jaw at chin height.
A dangling plait of scalp hair with a continuous woven sequence down its length.
The two pointy pieces belong to the baseball cap itself, with their bottom edges attached to the cap fabric.
A pirate hat with its brim lifted on three sides to make three corners.
The left and right sewn panels of the same jacket have different colors, divided by the panel edge.
기계 다리의 단단한 부품들이 나뉘어 있고 이웃 부품 사이에 둥근 관절 연결 면이 노출된다.
몸에서 이어진 꼬리는 하나인데 먼 끝에서만 가지 두 개로 갈라져 있다.
목 주변 털이 방사형으로 부풀어 있으며 같은 동물의 몸 털에 이어지는 형태.
A creature's arm ends in a claw with two opposing jaws and an opening between them.
A single large flower rises on a visible stalk above the spread leaves over the creature's back.
The face is a flat drawing on the loose outer covering; the actual head remains hidden underneath.
리본을 착용한 것이 아니라 생물 머리와 목에 이어진 길고 납작한 부속이 두 가장자리를 유지하며 늘어진다.
